tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /longs spyod 'phel thabs klu'i bum gter 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas dang lto 'phye brtag tshul longs spyod 'phel thabs gzhan dang bcas bzhugs/
༄༅/ /longs spyod 'phel thabs klu'i bum gter 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas dang lto 'phye brtag tshul longs spyod 'phel thabs gzhan dang bcas bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /longs spyod 'phel thabs klu'i bum gter 'dod dgu'i

'byung gnas dang lto 'phye brtag tshul longs spyod 'phel thabs gzhan dang bcas bzhugs/ na mo nā ga rā dze shwa ra ya/ /'dod dgu 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun sel ba/ /nor rgyas la sogs klu rgyal 'khor bcas la/ /btud nas bum gter mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /de la 'dir rang gzhan gyi longs spyod 'phel ba la sogs pa'i thabs su bum gter bya tshul ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ klu nor rgyas gyi bu la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzugs bcug la/ rin po che sna tshogs dang zhes pa nas/ thun mong gi nor rdzas la longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /zhag bdun du snying bo rgyun ma chad par bzlas na dbul ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la bzhi/ bum pa'i rgyu dang tshad kyi khyad par/ rdzas kyi khyad par/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul/ gnas gang du ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ngor chen gyis bum pa yul gang yin gyi bre tshad las mi chung ba'i bcud shong ba lcags dang ra gan zha nye ma 'dres pa'i rin po che'i bum pa'am/ rdza la sogs pa'i bum pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /yul 'di'i dbang du byas na bre ni shing tsher grags pa la'ang rung bar mngon no/ khyad par mdzod bum la rgyu sngar bshad pa ltar la tshad rgyud sde nas bshad pa ltar grub na legs so/ /de lta bu'i bum pa rang bzhin dkar ba yin mi dgos la/ /min na dkar rtsis byugs te bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo bri zhing mdun gang yong ngos nor bu 'bar ba 'bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ske tshe/ shangs tshe/ bra'o ma gtogs pa'i gro nas sogs 'bru sna gang rnyed dang*/ klu la gnod pa'i rdzas khyung sder/ tsha ba gsum/ gla rtsi sogs dang dug rigs ma 'dres pa'i sman sna dang klu sman rnyed tshad/ lcags zha nye ra gan ma gtogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs tsan dan dkar dmar a ka ru sogs klu la mi gnod pa'i dri bzang gang rnyed/

sha chang ma 'dres pa'i zas sna gos sna/ ba ra'i dkar gsum/ mngar gsum gyi ril bu/ mi btsan phyugs grib can ma yin pa dag gi lag nas byung ba'i 'bru sna sogs dang*/ mi chen phyugs po pho mo nor can dang*/ nor lha rnams kyi ming bris pa'ang gzhug par bshad de/ nor lha'i mtshan gyi mthar 'dod don 'phel ba'i spel tshig sbyar na shin tu legs/ gsum pa ni/ 'byor na klu sman sna tshogs dang khams bzang po bsres par klu chen brgyad gtso bo yab yum dang bcas pa'i gzugs bya ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ klu nor rgyas kyi bu la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzugs bcug la rin po che sna tshogs dang klu sman sna tshogs dang 'bru sna tshogs kyi legs par bkang ba zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ma 'byor na/ klu dbang dang klu'i gzugs gnyis ka 'bri ba'am/ brkos te mtshal gyis bar du 'debs pa'ang mthong zhing*/ gang ltar yang rgyas par na phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa brgyad so sor klu chen po brgyad dang dbus kyi bum pa'i smad du longs spyod 'phel ba la klu nor rgyas yab yum dang*/ mtsho chu rgyas pa'i ched yin na/ wa ru ṇa gtso bor byed pa yin pas gang 'dod pa de bcug la/ de'i steng gi char de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gtso 'khor lnga'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs pa'am/ yang na phyogs bzhi dang dbus su bum pa re re ste lnga dang*/ yang na bum pa steng 'og gnyis su byas pa'i 'og ma'i nang du klu 'khor bcas dang steng ma'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs par yang bshad de/ klu sgrub kyis/ bum pa gnyis po yang 'og tu klu'i bum pa bzhag/steng du bcom ldan 'das kyi bum pa bzhag ces gsungs so/ /'on kyang slob dpon kyis sgrub thabs las/ bum pa gnyis las gzhan bya bar ma gsungs te/ de nyid las/ bum pa gnyis las gcig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs dang rin po che dang 'bru sna tshogs kyis gang bar bya'o/

/gcig tu klu nor rgyas kyi bu la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzugs bcug la rin po che sna tshogs kyis lag par bkang ba zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bum pa rnams kyi nang du 'og gi sgrub thabs kyi rim pa ltar gzugs bcug ste 'bru sna tshogs kyis legs par bkang la rdza 'dam sogs kyis la bcad la de dag stegs kyi khar gzhi gtsang ma la pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas par bum pa dgu go rim bzhin bkod pa'am/ bum pa gnyis byed tshe pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis kyi lte ba dang*/ bum pa gcig las med na de bstun gyis gcig gi lte bar 'god/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod tshar ci 'byor dang*/ mtho'ang bcom ldan 'das dang klu 'khor bcas la so sor char re re ste tshar gnyis tsam bshams pa'i logs su gtor ma gsum dang 'byor na mtha' bskor du mchod pa gzhan yang bshams dgos ste/ slob dpon kyis gtor ma gsum byas la zhes pa nas/ bar dmar po gnyis kyi 'o ma ma god pa dang*/ gdugs brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ mtshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ a ka ru nag po'i bdug spos dang*/ spos dkar dang*/ bdug pa sna tshogs dang*/ me tog dang*/ mar me dang*/ lha bshos dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rdzas yo byad rnams legs par tshogs par na gnas khang yid du 'ong bar 'dug ste/ thogs mar bgegs gtor gtong bar gsungs pas/ de'i tshul ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du btang la/ rang nyid skad cig gis khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi skur nas bgegs gtor spyi 'gro ltar gtong ngo*/ /de nas / rang nyid skad cig gis klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po sku mdog rin po che mi dpog pa'i mdog lta bu sprul mgo bdun gdengs pa'i rgyab yol can/ chos gos gsol zhing dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya can du gyur/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal bo gtso 'khor lnga la bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas kyis 'khor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn mo ta thā ga tā bha ga wan nā ga rā dze shwa re bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod cing*/ rin po che dang gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod par bsams te/ oṃ sarba bi sho dha pū dza me gha bha ba s+phā ra ṇa sa mu dra hūṃ zhes pa brjod/ de nas/ oṃ swā bhā wa shung+ngha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shung+ngho3haṃ/ chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du a dkar bo 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nyi gang ba'i steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūṃ yig rin po che mi dpog pa'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu la sogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag nas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal bo'i go 'phang la bkod tshur 'dus hūṃ yig la thim pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po sku mdog rin po che mi dpog pa'i mdog lta bu sprul mgo bdun gdengs pa'i rgyab yol can/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan cing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ sems can thams cad ngan 'gro dang klu thams cad klu'i skyes gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya can/ bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan par gyur pa'i bdun du pad zla'i gdan la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang g.yon bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas su pad zla'i gdan la byams pa sku mdog dmar po/

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas klu shing gi mgo lcogs me tog dang bcas pa dang*/ g.yon ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ rgyab tu pad zla'i gdan la 'jam dpal sku mdog gser gtso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag nyis kyis ut+pal bsnams pa/ g.yon du pad zla'i gdan la spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma bsnams pa/ bzhi ka'ang dbu skra ral ba thor gtsugs su bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing lha rdzas kyi dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing gtso bo la blta ba/ de dag gi g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom pa rnams dang*/ 'og phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rin po che thogs pa thal mo sbyar nas gyen du blta ba/ gtso 'khor lnga'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ de las 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i klu'i dbang phyug rgyal bo'i gtso 'khor lnga'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyod rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rnam snang dang 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nā ga rā dze shwa ra sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar kyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ / sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod la/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla gdan gyis steng du hūṃ y-ig gi mtha' skor du/

bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur bar bsams la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā bha ga wan na ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi ti swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /bzlas ba rab 'bum phrag bcu gcig bya bar bshad kyang*/ bsdu na 'bum gsum mam gcig bzla bar bshad/ sarba yod med gnyis snang yang med pa bde snyam/ mthar yig brgyas brtan par byas te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs kyi bsngo smon kyis rgyas btab bo/ /de nas dkar gtor gsum chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa kyis mchod gtor dang yo byad rnams bsangs/ swā bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che sna tshogs dang 'bru bcud zas nor gos sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprin gyis nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur bar mos nas/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni thal mo khong stong byas pa skal bas bdag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shung+ngha sarba dharmā bi shung+ngho3haṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas mang bor spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tsha ི gas bar ma rnams bcag la dpral bar bzhag ste/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shū mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra na i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags rgyas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye te mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa ces dang*/ rgya che shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher thob par bya ba ni/ g.yon khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/

zhes pa dang*/ ye shes dkar zla'i 'od kyi sngags rgyas 'dod dgur thob par bya ba ni/ /g.yas khu tshur bca ི ngas ba snying khar bzhag/g.yon mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa'i mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ke te sa man+ta s+pha ra na risma bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇ-i du ru du ru hri da la/ dz+wa la ni hūṃ/ zhes dang / dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'i lha spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis bshigs te bsgrengs la/ na maḥs man+ta budha naṃ/ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes pas mgron thams cad kyis/ dam tshig gi bdag la 'go zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub par bsam te/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bstan nas sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs par brjod/ sngags la cung zad mi 'dra ba'ang yod do/ /de ltar sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis rdzas rnams bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ bsdu na kun rig gi cha gsum nang ltar sngags rgyas lan gsum byin gyis brlabs kyang rung ngo*/ /da nas bum pa bsangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bum pa longs spyod dang chu mtsho dpag bsam gyis shing ljon pa sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūṃ yig mi dpog pa'i rin po che'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas/ zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i rang bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bya la/ mthar yig rgya brjod de/ mchod bstod kyang bya'o/ /de nas 'das gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ / bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur par bsams la/ nyer gcig gam bdun gyis phul/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang gnas khang sa phyogs 'di nyid byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes thal mo sbyar la gsol ba gdab bo/

/gtor ma gnyis pa'ang bya spyod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ a kā ro yan bdun gyis 'jig rten skyong ba dang gzhi bdag la phul nas 'phrin las bcol bas 'dod don khas blangs bar bsam mo/ /de nas klu'i bum pa so so'i gcig las med kyang khyad par shes par byas te/ klu'i bum pa phyi bum pa la nang klu'i pho brang rin po che las grub pa'i rgya phib dang rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa khor yug tu bya skyib brag ri spang ljongs mtsho rdzing bu nags tshal me tog dang*/ chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrog pas bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar phuḥsngon po yongs su gyur pa las klu'i rgyal bo nor rgyas sku mdog sngon po sprul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du yum klu mo nor bu'i cod paṇa can sprul mgo'i gdengs ka lnga dang ldan pa phyag gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pas thal mo sbyar nas yab la 'dud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rim pa bzhin du shar du phuḥdakar po/ /lhor phuḥsngo skya/ nub tu phuḥdamar po/ /byang du phuḥsngon po/ /shar lhor phuḥdakar po/ /lho nub tu phuḥsngo skya/ nub byang du phuḥser po/ /byang shar du phuḥdakar bo rnams yongs su gyur pa las klu chen brgyad du gyur pa ni phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la shar du stobs kyi rgyu dkar bo/ /lhor dung skyong sngo skya/ nub tu mtha' yas ser ba/ /byang du wa ru ṇa sngon po/ /mtshams bzhi'i 'dab ma la/ shar lhor 'jog po dmar bo/ /lho nub tu rigs ldan sngo skya/ nub byang du pad+ma ser po/ /byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar bo/ /klu chen brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bum pa bzung nas gtso bo la 'dud cing sprul gyi gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi gtsug tu yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i brgyan dang bcas pa'i stod lha'i rnam pa la rin po che'i rgyan dang na bza' gsol zhing smad sprul mjug tu 'khyil ba/

de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ e h+ye hi nā ga rā dzā a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang rang gi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/

de nas mchod gtor byin gyi sa rlabs te/ oṃ phuḥphuḥnā ga ra dza sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyi bar rol mo bcas mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi/ / zhes bstod/ de nas gtor ma mtshan sngags so so'i mthar a ka ro btags la 'bul ba'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ hi li hi li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ gsum gyis bsngos la/ klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams las/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ / nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / zhes pa'i bar gyis 'phrin las bcol bas khas blangs bar bsam/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba na ི / rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyi zugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs ka'i phuḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dbang dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bkug ste bum nang gi rdzas dang gnas khang la sogs par thim pas mi mdzad pa'i gter gyi phung bor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ba su ki phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā kar koṭa ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā shaṅkha pā la ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dza ā nan+ta ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā wa ru ṇa ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā tak+ṣa kā ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā ku li kā ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā pad+ma ya phuḥswāhā/ oṃ phuḥnā ga rā dzā ma hā pad+ma ya phuḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa ci 'grub sogs bya/ yig brgyas brtan par byas te slar yang mchod cing bstod la/

/grub na klu gtor yang gtor zhing*/ bum pa zhag bdun nam gsum du bsgrub po/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'dom gang la sogs pa'i sa brkos pa'i 'og tu byi dor legs par byas shing 'og dang logs rnams su g.yam ba bzang po'i rdo khang*/ rtsig pa dang mdzod lta bur 'jog kyang rung*/ rang gi khang ba'i shar ngos su byed pa'i gzhi der klu sman sogs bcas 'og tu klu'i bum pa dang steng du de bzhin gshegs pa'i bum pa bzhag go /gal te bum pa gcig las ma rnyed na de'i nang gi 'og tu klu rnams dang steng du bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas bskyed dgos so/ /bum pa dgu la sogs pa yod na ni/ phyogs mtshams ji ltar yin pa ma nor bar 'jug cing steng du'ang g.yam pa bzang bos bkab pa'i sgrom legs par byas pa'i steng du sa gtsang mas bkang ste 'thas par bya'o/ /grub na zhag bdun la sogs par klu gtor dang mchod pa byas pa'i steng du gtsug lag khang dang rten bzhengs pa'am/ de ltar min kyang rung ste bum pa gang du bcug pa'i yul der dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa mang bo 'byung bar gsungs shing*/ khyad par du klu dbang rgyal bo'i sgrub thabs las/ khang ba'i shar du gter du sbas na phongs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ / klu'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim de'i skyes pa dang bud med thams cad dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ mtshams su de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal bo'i mtshan nyid shu rtsa re re brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar klu dbang gi mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal ba dang 'dod don 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs byas na don gang yin bde 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / smras pa/ phan bde'i longs spyod 'byung gnas bum gter zhes/ /rgya bod mkhas pa dag la rab grags kyang*/ /tshul bzhin phyag len shes pa dkon mthong nas/

/mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du legs par bkod/ /ces pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gi don du dam pa'i man ngag bzhin 'jug pa bde bar sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// //༄༅/ /lto 'phye brtag tshul dang longs spyod 'phel thabs ni/ na mo badz+ra dhā ra ye/ 'dir lto 'phye brtag pa'i tshul sogs 'chad pa la gsum de brtag pa dang*/ bskyed cing mchod pa sogs dang*/ longs spyod 'phel thabs gzhan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ /bai dkar nas 'byung ba dang*/ sngags rim nas bshad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gzhi gang du sa gzhi ji ltar 'tsham pa byi dor byas la/ thig chen brgyad po spyi ltar gdab cing che chung ji ltar rigs par byas te/ phyogs bzhir cha chen bcu bcur phye ba las/ nang gses kyis cha phran dgu re gdab/ de ltar byas kyang phyogs re re'u mig dgu bcu re 'byung ba ni/ khyim zla sum re'i zhag dang grangs mnyam zhing*/ mtha'i re'u mig kun bsdoms pa ni khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu dang mtshungs so/ /de yang lto 'phye ni/ gdengs ka dang ldan zhing stod mi la smad sbrul mjug can/ lag pa g.yon rna ba g.yon pa la bkab cing*/ g.yas rin po che dkur bten pa/ lus kyi dkyus su mtho bcu ba/ zheng la yang rang zhal do/ /gdengs ka rang zhal snying ga gsang gnas bcas mtho lnga dang*/ sbrul mjug nyid mtho lnga ste/ lus la klu chen po brgyad gnas so/ /nag rtsis 'di lugs kyi brgyad pa dgu na ra ba bu mo'i khyim nas brtsams te/ thog mar shar lho nas g.yas bskor du khyim zhag re la cha chung re spyod cing*/ brgyad pa dgu ba bcu ba ste dgun gsum la mgo lho/ /bcu gcig pa sogs dpyid gsum la mgo nub/ gnyis pa sogs dbyar gsum la mgo byang*/ lnga ba sogs ston gsum la mgo shar du blta'o/ /hor zla dgu ba bcu gnyis pa gsum pa drug pa ste 'bring bo bzhi'i zhag po bco lnga'i dus su ni phyogs kyi tshangs thig nas mgo bo gnas so/

/sa dmigs dngos grub blang ba'i tshul ni/ /dper na/ dbyar 'bring bo hor zla gsum pa'i bco lnga la bab ba'i skabs yin na/ mgo byang mjug ma lhor bstan la/ byang nas cha chen gsum la gdengs ka dang zhal dang snying ga gsum ste cha phran phyed dang nyer brgyad dor ba'i 'og der tshangs pa'i thig nas mdun ngos su cha phran bcu bzhi dor bas sa dmigs/ /shar nub tu phyed dang lnga dang*/ lho byang du phyed dang dgu'i cha phran gyi sa ni dngos grub blang ba'i gnas te/ mchod pa dang*/ brko tshul ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni khyim zhag gi dbang du byas pa'i lto 'phye brtag tshul lo/ /gnyis pa sngags rim nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod na/ sngags rim chen mo las/ gzhi gang yin grub bzhir byas pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi bo re re yang zla ba gsum gyi zhag grangs dang mthun par re'u mig dgu bcu re bya'o/ /de la lto 'phye gnas pa dang*/ rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ ston zla ra brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la mgo byang shar 'tshams kyi re'u mig tu bzhag nas nas mjug rtse lho nub kyi re'u mig tu bzhag ste kha lhor bltas nas gnas so/ /de nas zhag re song ba na mgos lho ngos su re'u mig re dang mjug rtses byang ngos su re'u mig re bgrod nas g.yas bskor gyis 'pho'o/ /zla ba gsum la phyogs re'i re'u mig dgu bcu re bgrod pas/ lo gcig la phyogs bzhi'i re'u mig dgu bcu pa phrag bzhi ga 'khor ro/ /de yang gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug nas nyal ba'i gdengs ka nas mjug rtse'i bar la mtho bcu yod la/ mtho res re'u mig dgu re non pas phyogs dang mtshams gang du gnas pa'i tshe yang re'u mig dgu bcu re non no/ /lus kyi zheng gis ni sa'i re'u mig gi cha dku khyab par nyal zhing gsang gnas ni phyogs mtshams gang la gnas pa'i tshe na'ang de'i dbus su bzhag nas gnas te/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang klu chen po brgyad kyang de'i mjug rtse sogs brgyad na gnas te/

zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brko ba'i gnas kyang*/ de nyid las/ mgo shar du bstan pa'i dbang du byas na mgos re'u mig gang non pa'i phyogs de nas re'u mig dgu gsum nyer bdun dor ba'i bar brkor mi rung bas mtshams de nas nub tu re'u mig dgu dang*/ rgyas kyi lus kyis non pa'i sa nas mdun du re'u mig phyed dang bcu bzhi'i bar brkor mi rung bas/ mtshams de nas lhor re'u mig phyed dang lnga ni dang por brko ba'i sa dmigs so/ /de ni mchan gyi mdun du bzhed pas/ mchan gyi thad du re'u mig dgu spangs par brko ba'i lugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di ni nyin zhag gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /lto 'phye ni mtha' gcig tu sa de dang der gnas par ma nges kyang*/ 'phrod mi 'phrod kyi rten 'brel brtag pa yin pas/ lugs gnyis gang byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags rim las/ de 'dra'i lto 'phye bsam la 'og ma la sogs pas mchod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ der lto 'phye'i gzugs 'bri ba'am ma bris kyang chog par sems la/ 'on kyang gzhi der lto 'phye nyid dngos su yod par mos nas mchod par bya dgos so/ /de'i phyir ma bskyed kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ bskyed par 'dod na/ thog mar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig sngon du btang ste/ rgyas par na sa bslang ba dang sbyang ba sogs byas la/ lto 'phye'i thig gdab/ grub de'i gzugs 'bri zhing*/ min na'ang sa dmigs nges par bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma yang bshams/ rko mkhan dang 'jor sogs sta gon byas te/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du sa bdag lto 'phye chen po stod mi la smad sprul 'jug can/ sku mdog dkar bo g.yas nor bu dkur brten cing*/ g.yon rna bar bkab pa/ nyal stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor mtha' yas sngon po/

/rna bar pad+ma dkar po/ /mgrin par 'jog po dmar po/ /snying khar nor rgyas ljang khu/ dpung bar pad+ma chen po ser po/ /lte bar rung skyong dkar bo/ /gsang gnas su stobs rgyu ljang khu/ mjug rtser rigs ldan sngon po rnams stod mi la smad sprul mjug can/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ sprul gyi gdengs ka dang rin po ches brgyan cing 'dzum pa'i nyams can tu gyur/ mchod gtor rnams so sor ram/ yang na/ bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor rnams bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ gsum dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha phruṃ phuḥswāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun sogs kyis/ gtor ma sogs bsngo/ / sa bdag lto 'phye chen po dang*/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing*/ /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang dang*/ /snyan grags legs tshogs gong du spel/ /gnas 'dir bkra shis byin chags shing*/ /'dod don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /lo legs rtsi bcud rgyas bar mdzod/ / zhes 'phrin las bcol/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi ltar bsngo/ /rko mkhan bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal bo bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i tog rtse dang*/ g.yon sdigs 'dzug mdzad pa/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs gsol zhing*/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur/ kha lto 'phye mgo po lta ba'i phyogs sam/ shar du phyogs te lam bzhi rgyab pa'i sa blangs nas gtor ma'i nang du'am/ phyi rol du dor la/ lto 'phye rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams ru nga dang phrag dog mi byed bar byams pa'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/

/ zhes brjod/ yang lto 'phye'i rgyab bam/ byang du bltas te phyogs bzhi dang dbus su/ kham lnga rgyab pa'i sa ni sa gzhi de'i dbus su 'gram/ de nas gzhan rnams kyis brkong rung*/ kha cig rko ba'i tshe/ kham bzhi rgyab pa ni shar du phyogs te/ shar nas khams gnyis dang*/ byang du phyogs te de nas kham gnyis te bzhi yin la/ kham lnga rgyab pa ni dbus su yin zer ba sogs mi 'dra ba'ang snang ngo*/ /gsum pa longs spyod 'phel thabs bai dkar nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod na/ shing tshe gang shong ba'i rdza bum gyi nang du/ rab spra tshil dang kham sa las klu nor rgyas sku sor brgyad pa stod mi la smad sprul 'jug can gdengs ka bdun ldan/ /g.yas la rin po che 'bar ba dang g.yon gter bum gyi kha la me tog ut+pal bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum klu mo sor bdun pa'am drug pa gdengs ka lnga ldan/ nor bu bcas phyag thal mo sbyar te yab la gzigs pa/ nor bu'i cod pan can/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ ba dmar dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang ghi wang gis byugs/ de 'dra ba'i klu rgyal yab yum gyi gzugs thum pa'i nang du gzhug /ma grub na bris pas kyang 'thus 'og mthar btsan phyug gi lag nas 'ongs ba'i 'bru sman dar sogs klu la mi gnod pa'i rigs dang*/ khyad par rin po lnga dang*/ nor lha rnams kyi mtshan/ che btsan phyugs po rnams kyi ming dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi ril bu sogs kyang 'jug cing*/ bum pa rang bzhin gyis dkar ba min na dkar rtsis byugs la/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang mdun ngos su nor bu 'bar ba bri/ klu thebs pa'i yar ngos tshes la/ klu'i bsnyen pa sngon du btang nas/ sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs te/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed rgyas sdus ci rigs byas nas/ rang nyid kha lhor bstan mdun du mañdzi sogs kyi steng du bum pa bzhag ste/ mthar ba ra'i dkar gsum dang mngar gsum chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/

rgyud sde 'og ma ltar byin brlab bya/ bum pa'i nang du klu'i pho brang dang der klu bskyed kyang rung la/ 'dir bsdus pa yin pas ma bskyed par gzugs brnyan nyid la klu bstim chog na'ang 'di bzhin bya ste/ mdun gyi klu'i gzugs brnyan 'di ni klu'i rgyal bo nor rgyas yab yum du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po nas klu'i rgyal bo nor rgyas yab yum skad cig gis gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes lan gsum gyis spyan drangs nas bstim la/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ba su ki la pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni/ /zhes sogs gyis bstod pa'am/ ma byas kyang rung*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad bsdus nas bum nang gi rdzas la thim par gyur bar bsams pa/ oṃ nā ga rā dzā ba su ki phuḥswāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod cing mchod bstod bya ba'am/ med kyang rung*/ gtor ma bya spyod ltar ram/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta khas khā hi khā hi/ zhes sbyar ba bdun nam gsum gyis phul la mchod bstod bya zhing*/ klu rgyal yab yum khyed rnams rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod rgya chen po mi zad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ / de nas bkra shis brjod de/ bum pa de mdzod la sogs par sba zhing*/ steng logs su nyi zla dang mchod rten 'bri'o/ /de ltar byas na longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur zhes bshad la/ bum gter rgyas pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar ro/ /yang longs spyod 'phel thabs la/ shog ras sogs gzhi gtsang ma la/ tshogs bdag dkar bo mi'i lus la glang gi gdong ba can phyag rin po ches bkang ba'i gzhongs pa bsnams pa'i snying khar oṃ āḥhūṃ ga na pa ti ye swā hā/ zhes bris la/ ye dharmās rab gnas byas te mdzod kyi phug tu bcug nas/ dus dus su mchod pa dang 'bras kyi dud pas bdug ste/ bdag gi longs spyod 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba mang du btab na longs spyod 'phel bar bshad do/ /yang tshogs bdag dang dzaṃ lha dang nor rgyun ma dang dpal lha la sogs pa'i nor lha'i sku bris te/ 'og tu so so'i snying bo dang 'phrin las bcol ba bri/ rin po che brdar ba'i dri'i chus byugs te rab gnas byas nas mchod bstod gsol gdab dang khyad par du bzang bor gu gul dang 'bras kyi dud pas bdug cing mchod pa dang gong bzhin gsol 'debs byas na'ang longs spyod 'phel lo/ /yang thod pa srub med pa'i nang du 'bru sna ring bsrel khyad par can rnams bcug stai/ rab gnas byas la/ ro ras kyis bkag rgyal rigs kyi bu mos bkal ba'i tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings pa khyim du bzhag na'ang longs spyod 'phel lo/ /yang phyugs 'phel thabs ni/ rdza bum gsar ba'i nang du bag phye dngul chu klu sman rnams bsres pa'i ril bus bkang nas kha bcad de phyugs ra'i nang du sba shing sgo'i them la bar+ṇa sha ba ri'i gzungs bris na legs bar bshad do/

/yang phyugs ra byed pa'i ra ba'i dbus dang mdzod kyi 'og tu rta gnag la sogs pa'i sems can kyi ltag gong ru sa sna mang bo brdungs nas sba ba'am/ zur bzhir sbas na'ang legs par bshad do/ /yang phyogs bzhir mdzod kyi nang du sangs rgyas gyi ring bsrel dang rin po che sna tshogs dang sman dang 'bru dang bum rdzas dang sa'i lha mo'i gzugs byas te bcug nas mchod bstod gsol gdab byas na legs bar bshad do/ / yang god ka byung na g.yag ra lugs gsum 'bras bu can zhig las tig mig med shu dag dkar bo gla rtsi rnams dar ram ras dkar bo'i nang du bcug ste/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas phyugs de'i ske la btags te bkra shis brjod cing*/ de klu'i rgyal bo nor rgyas dang yul de'i lha klu gzhi bdag la bsngos na legs par bshad do/ /yang lha 'dre'i gnod pas god ka byung na/ drag po'i mnan pa byas na legs par bshad do/ /yang gzhung gzhan nas/ rnam sras 'dzam lha nor rgyun ma dpal lha mo sogs nor lha'i sgrub mchod byas na nor dang longs 'phel bar bshad do/ /yang bai dkar las/ yul khams bkra shis 'byung 'dod pas/ / shar du ljon shing khyad 'phags 'dzug /lho ru bum gter bzang bo gzhug /nub tu rigs gsum mgon po brtsigs/ /byang du tshad ldan mchod rten bzhengs/ / zhes bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /ces pa 'di ni/ gnas brtan dpal 'byor rgya mtshos gzhan la'ang phan snyam pa'i bsam pas bskul ba ltar/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis mkhas pa'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/klu'i bum gter dang lto 'phye brtag tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 298-- PAGE 297- - PAGE 280-
